contexts.text: The Angels said to me, Write about (love truly conjugial), and follow the revelation; and afterwards the Book written about it shall be let down by us from Heaven, and we shall see whether the things contained in it are received...
(The Conjugial Love referred to.) ISB 11:end. BE 55. TCR 19:end. TCR 313. TCR 607. CanonsNC 42. Trinity. 4. 5. Coro 36, etc.
